meta.title: Veronika Belousova — AI for Business
meta.description: Practical AI automation for sales, service, and CRM — designed, deployed, and scaled for measurable business outcomes.

hero.tagline: I design and roll out practical AI across sales, service, and CRM — solving concrete problems and delivering measurable impact on operations and revenue. The stack stays open: enterprise-ready models, modern data layers, and the systems you already use.

about.label: About
about.trustTitle: AI that earns trust in everyday work
trustParagraphs: Anyone can plug in a chatbot. Building AI that staff actually use — and that improves forecast accuracy, response time, or win rate — is a different job.
My background in journalism and marketing helps me ask precise questions, hear the real process behind the request, and translate it into clear product requirements.
In delivery I combine that with code and integration work — connecting models, CRM, and workflows so form, meaning, and day-to-day usefulness stay aligned.

services.label: AI for Business
services.heading: AI solutions across core business functions
services.intro: Intelligent automation for teams that need clear ROI — from pipeline quality and service speed to marketing relevance and CRM readiness. Built around your processes, not a vendor checklist.

items.title: Sales
items.detail: Predictive analytics to sharpen forecasting and prioritize the right deals. Pipeline forecasting, deal scoring, and sales optimization that help teams focus where win probability is highest.

items.title: Service
items.detail: Smarter service operations with AI agents that classify cases, route work, and automate routine steps — so resolution gets faster and cost per ticket goes down.

items.title: Marketing
items.detail: AI-assisted campaign tuning and content support: optimize spend and messaging, generate assets faster, and personalize journeys with clearer intent signals.

items.title: Agent CX
items.detail: Salesforce Agentforce and related agent experiences for stronger customer engagement — from guided conversations to assisted workflows inside the CRM you already trust.

items.title: Quoting
items.detail: Dynamic pricing and automated quote flows that cut manual effort, reduce errors, and keep commercial offers consistent with your pricing rules.

items.title: Finance
items.detail: AI support for financial operations and risk: forecasting, anomaly and fraud signals, and planning inputs that help finance move with more confidence.

items.title: HR
items.detail: Smarter hiring and people workflows: CV screening, interview agents, and talent pipelines that reduce admin load without losing human judgment where it matters.

items.title: Contract management
items.detail: Intelligent review of agreements — clause extraction, risk flags, and faster analysis so legal and sales can close with clearer visibility.

items.title: Order management
items.detail: Demand forecasting and order optimization that improve fulfillment planning, inventory decisions, and day-to-day operational rhythm.

items.title: Salesforce AI
items.detail: Enterprise-grade AI on Salesforce: CRM cleanup and setup, sales AI enablement, service automation, marketing activation, Customer 360 views, data/AI integrations, and CRM-driven process automation — each with a clear business impact.

items.title: Strategy & support
items.detail: End-to-end guidance: cross-functional AI strategy and governance, business-case prioritization, conversational CX, personalization at scale, workflow automation, analytics for decisions, ongoing monitoring, and adoption programs so teams actually use what you ship.

items.title: Platforms
items.detail: Open stack — ChatGPT / OpenAI, Claude / Anthropic, Azure AI, Gemini, Llama, Mistral, AWS Bedrock, and custom or on-premise models. We pick what fits the use case — no single-vendor lock-in.

deployment.label: Infrastructure
deployment.heading: Deploy AI where your data and policies allow
deployment.intro: Pick the hosting model that matches your security bar, compliance rules, and how your teams operate day to day.

packages.title: Public cloud AI
packages.summary: Run on proven enterprise public-cloud platforms when speed and elasticity matter most.
points: Fast go-live with room to scale
Usage-based costs that grow with demand
Recovery patterns built into the stack

packages.title: Private cloud AI
packages.summary: A dedicated cloud tenancy when you need stronger governance without leaving the cloud model.
points: Tighter control over data and access
Isolated cloud resources for your org
Architecture prepared for audits and compliance
Security settings tailored to your policies
Stronger encryption options end to end

packages.title: On-premise AI
packages.summary: Install inside infrastructure you own and operate when sovereignty and isolation are non-negotiable.
points: Full control over where data lives
Runs on client-managed hardware and networks
Hardware choices fitted to your stack
Highest bar for security and regulated use
No outbound data paths unless you choose them

process.label: How it works
process.heading: A structured path to AI that sticks
process.intro: A clear sequence from opportunity to scale — so every step has owners, milestones, and success metrics.

steps.title: Discovery & assessment
steps.detail: We map your processes and spot high-impact AI opportunities with realistic constraints and data readiness in mind.

steps.title: Strategy & planning
steps.detail: A tailored roadmap with priorities, milestones, and measurable outcomes — before heavy build begins.

steps.title: Implementation
steps.detail: Deploy AI into live workflows with minimal disruption to the systems and teams already running the business.

steps.title: Optimization & scale
steps.detail: Monitor performance, refine models and prompts, and expand capabilities across functions as results prove out.

projects.title: s:stebler
projects.description: Multilingual website for a Swiss manufacturer of intelligent space solutions — product pillars, news, events, and showroom journeys with a precise architectural visual language. I contributed to the project as part of a collaborative team.

items.quote: Veronika built the site for our gallery, The Golden Horse, and from the first call it felt like she was inside the project with us — not just ticking boxes. She really got what we care about: art, horses, and the story we want to leave behind. The result is elegant, calm, and true to us. I’m genuinely happy to share the link with collectors and friends.
items.name: Daria Tretskova
items.role: Co-owner of the art gallery, Art manager, Art producer, horse rider

items.quote: Veronika quickly understood the specifics of our work — complex and trust-driven. The website turned out clear, structured, and highly professional. I especially appreciated her attention to detail and smooth communication throughout the project.
items.name: Elena Kashporova

items.quote: It was important for me to reflect the atmosphere of our café — style, taste, and mood. Veronika captured it perfectly. The website looks beautiful, is easy to use, and truly helps us get more bookings.
items.name: Oksana Golovanova
items.role: Chef & Founder, KITCHEN by True Taste

items.quote: As a creative agency, we have high standards — and Veronika delivered. Clean code, strong design, and a clear understanding of business needs. Working with her was both easy and professional.
